record.question: The Central Government of India has set a target of providing clean drinking water to all by the year
record.explanation: Answer D: 2024. The Minister of Jal Shakti publicly stated on 11 June 2019 that the target was tap water to every household by 2024, before this June 2019 sitting. The expected option is 2024. Reference: https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-news/tap-water-to-each-household-by-2024-says-union-minister-gajendra-singh-shekhawat/story-r2QYFhCMS42eUzG0e9g2kO.html. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
